attack_techniques: Remote Services: Direct Cloud VM Connections (T1021.008)
attackers_goals: Gaining unauthorized access, executing unauthorized commands, or compromising sensitive information within the target system.
description: An identity executed an AWS SSM Document.
investigative_actions: Examine the code in the SSM document, and the target objects. Validate the permissions and roles associated with the user initiating the SSM session to ensure they align with the expected level of access. Follow further actions taken by the identity or on the relevant targets.
